53.60836,-10.0015: Oliver St John Gogarty. 1878 - 1957. Poet and Surgeon. Lived here.
53.97443,-10.08526: Paul Henry 1876 - 1958 Irish artist lived and worked here and at other locations in Achill 1918 - 1919
53.97471,-10.12994: Don Allum the first man to row across the Atlantic in both directions landed on the rocky shore down from this memorial, from St. John's Newfoundland on 4th September 1987 completing the second leg of his epic voyage in a 19 ft. 10 ins. plywood open boat, the QE 3, after 77 days at sea.
